latest_release.name: NectarLink 0.1.5 Pollen
latest_release.body:
The PC app on Linux and on Windows on ARM, Phone as microphone, Play on phone, your phone's sound on the PC, a Nightly channel, and the fixes for what people reported since 0.1.4.

### Downloads

| Download | For | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| [Nectarlink-0.1.5-x64-setup.exe](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/Nectarlink-0.1.5-x64-setup.exe) | Windows | Windows 10 (2004+) or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (Phone as webcam needs Windows 11) |
| [Nectarlink-0.1.5-arm64-setup.exe](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/Nectarlink-0.1.5-arm64-setup.exe) | Windows on ARM | Windows 11 on ARM (Snapdragon) |
| [nectarlink_0.1.5_amd64.deb](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/nectarlink_0.1.5_amd64.deb) | Ubuntu, Debian | Ubuntu 24.04 or newer, Debian 13, 64-bit Intel or AMD |
| [nectarlink-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/nectarlink-0.1.5-1.x86_64.rpm) | Fedora, openSUSE | Fedora 40 or newer, 64-bit Intel or AMD |
| [Nectarlink-0.1.5-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/Nectarlink-0.1.5-x86_64.AppImage) | Other Linux | A distribution from 2024 or newer, 64-bit Intel or AMD |
| [Nectarlink-0.1.5-linux-x86_64.tar.gz](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/Nectarlink-0.1.5-linux-x86_64.tar.gz) | Other Linux | As the AppImage |
| [Nectarlink-0.1.5-android.apk](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/Nectarlink-0.1.5-android.apk) | Android | Android 8.0 or newer |

All are listed with their SHA-256 hashes in [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/download/v0.1.5/SHA256SUMS.txt). On Linux, `curl -fsSL https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` picks the right one. Installed copies update themselves.

### New

- **Nix flake.** `nix run` starts the PC app on Linux, and `nix develop` gives a development shell. Thanks to [@m-uvex](https://github.com/m-uvex) ([#173](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/pull/173)).
- **Delete photos from the PC.** Select them on the Photos page and they go to the phone's trash, where you can still restore them. It needs All files access on the phone ([#174](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/issues/174)).
- **SD cards in File Explorer.** With All files access, an SD card or USB drive in the phone shows as a folder of its own (such as **SD card**) beside the internal storage's folders. Before Android 11, Android lets apps only read SD cards ([D#149](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/discussions/149)).
- **Turkish.** The Android and PC apps speak Turkish (Türkçe): pick it in Settings, or they follow the system's language. Thanks to [@sedatdagg](https://github.com/sedatdagg).
- **Your phone's sound on the PC, without mirroring.** **Phone sound on this PC** on Home plays what the phone plays through the PC's speakers or headphones, with no mirror window. With Elevated it starts right away; otherwise the phone asks once, as for mirroring. The phone goes quiet meanwhile and its media volume comes back after ([#94](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/issues/94)).
- **Sharing your PC's screen with the phone uses H.265** when both sides can, and H.264 otherwise. Thanks to [@AS8148](https://github.com/AS8148) ([#66](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/pull/66)).
- **Hardware video for screen sharing on Linux.** With FFmpeg 6 to 9 installed, sharing the PC's screen and showing a shared screen use the GPU (VAAPI, NVIDIA or Intel QSV) and fall back to software H.264 when it can't. Thanks to [@AS8148](https://github.com/AS8148) ([#67](https://github.com/thtbee/nectarlink/pull/67)).
- **Elevated over USB.** Plug the phone into the PC with USB debugging allowed and Elevated starts by itself, without setting up Wireless debugging. It runs while the cable is in, and needs Android's `adb` running on the PC (Google's platform-tools, then `adb start-server`). The PC only
